# Edmund Carrow

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Role:** Operative of the Ministry of Umbral Affairs

## Appearance

Edmund Carrow is described as a sharp-featured man with severe graying hair and pale eyes that project a cold, analytical demeanor. He favors dark, high-collared attire suited for formal Ministry duty and concealed tactical maneuvers. His stance is rigid, reflecting years of disciplined service within subterranean and clandestine operations.

## Personality

Carrow is ruthless, methodical, and fanatically loyal to the Ministry's doctrine of containment and control. He views human lives as secondary to maintaining secrecy and neutralizing arcane anomalies. Beneath his stoic demeanor lies a deeply suspicious nature, making him quick to execute harsh measures against suspected heretics or compromised agents.

## Traits

- Methodical and calculating
- Ruthlessly loyal to the Ministry
- Suspicious of arcane influences

## Abilities

- Interrogation and covert tracking
- Proficiency with suppressive warding artifacts
- Tactical leadership in subterranean breach actions

## Goals

- Contain and purge corruptive arcane artifacts
- Maintain the authority and secrets of the Ministry

## History

Edmund Carrow appears as a senior investigator dispatched by the Ministry to oversee the containment of the breach. In Volume 3, he enforces strict blockades and authorizes harsh interrogations against local residents suspected of exposure to corrupted artifacts. During Volume 4, he coordinates the assault on the subterranean ruins to secure the core anomaly before rival factions can claim it. His uncompromising methods bring him into direct conflict with the protagonists when he orders the liquidation of compromised survivors. In Volume 5, during a catastrophic collapse within the lower vaults, Carrow attempts to seal an uncontained rift by force, leading to his fatal betrayal and death amidst the cascading arcane backlash.

## Background by volume

- Rose through the ranks of the Ministry of Umbral Affairs through ruthless efficiency
- Overseer of several clandestine purging operations prior to his deployment to the lower districts

## Affiliations

- Ministry of Umbral Affairs — Senior Enforcement Officer
